passages.title: The City Gate
text: At dawn, you reach a city whose banners have outlasted its kings.
A messenger waits beside the open gate. Beyond them, a bell calls the council to order.

passages.title: A Quiet Warning
text: The messenger lowers their voice. 'The council needs a ruler. First, they need someone who will listen.'
They step aside, leaving the road to the council hall clear.

passages.title: The Empty Chair
text: Inside the council hall, an empty chair stands at the head of the table.
Every voice falls silent as you enter. Your story is only beginning.
